author: BoldAndBrash
body:
Gonna try to get Kylo or Javi or Pav to take a look at this ASAP.

Donor Ranks

GOLD
- 5,000 credits for donating <3
-2 more walls, nexus, and CTH kits
- Unlock 3 new badges 
- 2 new trails

EMERALD
- 7,500 credits for donating <3
- 1 more walls, nexus, and CTH kit
- Unlock 1 more new badge
- 1 new trail

DIAMOND
- 10,000 credits for donating <3
- 1 more walls, nexus, and CTH kit
- Unlock 1 more new badge!
- 1 new trail!

Advertisement

BANNER
- Update it weekly, have it catch people's attention. Make it colorful and have people know about what's new or why they should play.

SERVER LIST
- Update all info there, spiff it up!

VOTING
- Add voting rewards. 375 credits a vote. Top monthly voter will receive a GOLD rank for a month.


This is all I have for now. Hopefully I'll update it here and there!
